findings: Player Block 7 to 12, absorption 12 to 6, and cancellation leaving committed Block 5 remain visibly separate from HP; vertical emphasis remains.
One through five ordinary enemy columns keep each badge beside its own bar during their sequential block effects, with no collision with the neighboring bar.
Guardian 240/240 and its Block badge remain separately readable during pop and after ordinary restoration.
All six cancellation/restore sequences leave ordinary badge dimensions and the committed number visible; no stale scale or stuck effect was observed.
Normal flying-card movement, shields, actor emphasis, turn announcements and subsequent phase transition remain present; flying-card temporary occlusion is explicitly accepted by the user.

acceptanceRecommendations.basis: Original Block badge growth issue passes actual player, 1–5 enemy and Boss recorded sequences; displayed Block values track the fixture commands and native logs.
Vertical feedback and the other recorded effects remain present; all six actual cancel/complete sequences restore ordinary UI and committed values.

The original horizontal-scale negative control failed; corrected local feedback/layout suites passed, and this same-candidate native run provides the missing visual evidence. Parent retains the usual exact-current-PR CI gate; no additional flying-card pass is required.

completionRecommendation: TASK-4.1 may be completed under its original badge defect scope. Do not make the normal flying-card behavior or the unrun second candidate an M1 blocker.
limitations: Explicit encounter and Block state fixture; not natural encounter or balance acceptance.
